steps.say: Revolut home, light: clean, but every row shouts the same; good structure to start from.
Revolut Wealth in dark mode: the dark ground already reads more premium than the light one.
A PIN pad on saturated purple: friendly, not premium - loud colour, big round keys.
Old-school e-banking: dense tables, many colours, tiny type. This is the not-this.
A payment receipt: the amount as hero, quiet type, lots of air - a strong confirmation pattern.
The Apple Card: titanium white, almost nothing printed on it. Restraint as luxury.
JPMorgan Palladium: brushed metal, one engraved serif mark. Material and a single detail.
A mid-market card: bold logo, gloss blue, lots of printing - the opposite of the metal cards.

args.text: PREMIUM, pinned. Ground: deep near-black (#0E0F11), cards one step lighter, never pure white. Ornament: one mark per screen, engraved-looking, nothing glossy. Hierarchy: one hero number per screen; everything else small, grey, quiet. Type: a light high-contrast serif for hero numbers, a plain sans for the rest, wide letter-spacing on labels. Colour: monochrome plus one metal accent (warm champagne gold), no bright brand colours. Density: airy, generous margins, at most five rows visible. Corners: medium radius. Elevation: flat, separated by tone not shadow. NOT premium: many colours, bold logos, gloss, dense tables, every element the same weight.

steps.say: The vocabulary, pinned from the references: ground, ornament, hierarchy, type, colour, density - each with a value, and what it is not.

args.text: Home screen of a premium fintech app, a single phone screen shown flat and straight-on, full screen UI design, no hand, no device frame. Deep near-black background. At the top a small wide-spaced grey label TOTAL BALANCE and one hero number, 48,210.55, in a light high-contrast serif. Below it a dark charcoal card showing a minimal metal card with one engraved mark in warm champagne gold. Then three quiet transaction rows in small grey sans type with generous spacing. A thin bottom navigation with four line icons. Monochrome with one champagne-gold accent. Airy, flat, medium corner radius.
